source_control: Relax BOTH original source and exchanged destination under roots-only and collective COM coordinates. Each endpoint retains its own original perceived bond graph, total charge and spin.
selection: Eight of nine FIT parents per condition by fixed hash; one supported recorded pair per parent by a separate fixed hash. No energy/acceptance/connectivity outcome enters selection.
accounting: Same cap32 candidate energy evaluations per arm, with shared freshly re-evaluated initial endpoints and duplicate repeatability checks. Early convergence or line-search blocking is retained; do not call unequal actual counts exactly matched costs.
interpretation: Optimization teacher-feasibility diagnostic only. Finite endpoints are not global minima, equilibrium samples, a valid MH proposal, or evidence of a learned gain. Compare source-to-destination gaps under both mobility choices; retain force residuals, graph failures and every budget-exhausted arm.
